food.nominalDemandScope: Current NPC hunger decay .05 per game minute divided by one meal recovery 52; theoretical daily demand, not measured consumption or a sustainability verdict.
food.inventoryScope: Shop inventories and personal carried food only; excludes freight custody, ingredients, dishes and separate company stores. Consignment lots are ownership records already included in shop inventory and are not counted twice.

boundary: Requires all229 original actual counter recovery across128+256ticks; does not certify new hunger cases or everyone simultaneously fed, long term supply, medical treatment, full suite, art or hardware performance.
